follow-up time: Duration of second stage of labor
exposure: Angle of progression (AoP) measured by transperineal ultrasound
outcome: Mode of delivery (operative vs. spontaneous vaginal delivery)
Duration of second stage of labor
cohort: 137 nulliparous women with a singleton gestation at term
finding: An AoP less than 153 degrees was associated with a higher likelihood of requiring operative delivery and a longer second stage of labor.
mod_finding: Women with an AoP < 153 degrees had almost six times higher odds of requiring a cesarean delivery compared to those with an AoP ≥ 153 degrees.
